mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions show 35 degrees with a feel-like temperature of 27 under overcast skies near Verona Area High School, accompanied by a full moon tonight.

In city news, candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election covering all four aldermanic districts are available from the City Clerk, with nomination papers due January 5th. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with payment options including 24/7 drop boxes at City Center.
Looking at local events, Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 Thursday Nights are both taking place today. Tomorrow, Wisconsin Brewing Company hosts a 50 Years of Craft Brewing celebration.
In police news, on Monday, November 9th, an officer pulled over a swerving vehicle on Highway 18/151 and arrested the 61-year-old driver for a third-offence O W I.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM to serve up your daily favorites.
